components.name: ChatApp
components.doc: A complete chat screen: a list of conversations, the thread of the open one and a prompt box. Replies are simulated in the browser: a short "thinking" beat, then the answer streams in word by word and can be stopped, copied or regenerated. In a narrow container the conversation list turns into a drawer.

members.name: conversations
members.doc: Conversations the screen starts with. The first one is open.

members.name: suggestions
members.doc: Prompt ideas shown in an empty conversation.

members.name: reply
members.doc: Produces the simulated reply to a prompt. `attempt` grows by one on every regenerate. Replace it with your own canned answers.

members.name: onSend
members.doc: Called when the person sends a prompt, with the conversation it went to.

members.name: assistantName
members.doc: Name of the assistant, used in labels.

members.name: user
members.doc: The signed-in person shown at the foot of the conversation list.

members.name: speed
members.doc: Words per second of the streamed replies.

members.name: height
members.doc: Height of the screen, as a CSS length or a number of pixels. Defaults to the full viewport height.

members.name: className
members.doc: Class name added to the root element.

members.name: id
members.doc: Stable id of the message.

members.name: role
members.doc: Who wrote it.

members.name: text
members.doc: The message text. Blank lines split paragraphs.

members.name: state
members.doc: Where an assistant reply is: waiting to start, arriving, finished, or stopped early. User messages are always "done".

members.name: id
members.doc: Stable id of the conversation.

members.name: title
members.doc: Title shown in the list and above the thread.

members.name: updated
members.doc: Short label of when it last changed: "Now", "2h", "Yesterday".

members.name: messages
members.doc: Messages, oldest first.

members.name: title
members.doc: Short heading of the card.

members.name: prompt
members.doc: The prompt the card sends.

members.name: name
members.doc: Name shown at the foot of the conversation list.

members.name: detail
members.doc: Second line under the name, such as a plan or an email.

members.name: avatar
members.doc: Avatar image address.
